# JSON Forge

JSON Forge is a browser-based JSON editor, validator, formatter, visualizer, and sharing tool for developers working with structured data.

## Primary URLs

- [Home/editor](https://json.manthaa.dev/)
- [Sitemap](https://json.manthaa.dev/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots](https://json.manthaa.dev/robots.txt)

## Capabilities

- Edit JSON with Monaco Editor.
- Validate, prettify, minify, sort keys, search, copy, import, and export JSON.
- Convert JSONL and YAML imports into canonical JSON.
- Visualize JSON as a navigable graph.
- Inspect arrays and objects in table view and export tables as CSV.
- Compare JSON documents in a diff view.
- Generate, repair, and derive schemas from JSON through optional AI features.
- Create expiring public share links for JSON snapshots.

## Agent Notes

- The main user workflow is the single-page editor at `/`.
- Public share links use `/s/{slug}` and may expire.
- Mutating AI and share features are rate-limited.
- User-provided JSON may be large, malformed, or sensitive; avoid sending it to external services unless the user explicitly requests an AI action.
